baseline.note: Steady AI-predicted velocity field; particles trace that field in slow motion. Not a time-resolved CFD simulation.

candidate.note: Steady AI-predicted velocity field; particles trace that field in slow motion. Not a time-resolved CFD simulation.

constraints.protectedRegion: Cabin, greenhouse, lower body and fragile triangle regions fixed

provenance.fieldTransfer: Area-weighted cells to points, retained common display vertices.
provenance.forceConvention: Fresh upstream Fx in N; full surface integration.

reduction.limitation: Display approximation. Small features/extrema can be omitted; forces use every original cell.
reduction.method: VTK DecimatePro; preserve topology; retained original vertices

provenance.sensitivityConvention: Measured partial d(-Fx)/dX; explanatory only. Known raw repeatability limitation. No gradient step control.

noise.scope: Perturbation spread includes shape response; not surrogate error or physical uncertainty.
